item.text:
This pass added race-detector coverage for the exercised cluster paths. The happy path, conflict path, and minimal committed-majority divergence run under `-race` with **no DATA RACE warnings**; the divergence still fails its assertions as expected ([output](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_00-19-47-swiftpaxos_epaxos-baseline/work/audit_race_output.txt)).

`run_audit.sh` now reruns this race check alongside the finding suite, 100/500/1,000-seed campaigns, loss classifier, build, and source-identity verification.

The audit remains at **27 findings**, **42 failing finding tests**, and **5 passing controls**; the captured source is unchanged and builds cleanly. Results are recorded in [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_00-19-47-swiftpaxos_epaxos-baseline/work/report.md), [executive_summary.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_00-19-47-swiftpaxos_epaxos-baseline/work/executive_summary.md), [validation_matrix.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_00-19-47-swiftpaxos_epaxos-baseline/work/validation_matrix.md), and [handoff_check.txt](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_00-19-47-swiftpaxos_epaxos-baseline/work/handoff_check.txt).
